description: U.S. Census Bureau incorporated places, including cities, towns, villages, boroughs, consolidated-city balances, Washington, D.C., and Urban Honolulu, ranked by estimated residents on July 1, 2025.
source: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Division. Vintage 2025 Subcounty Resident Population Estimates (SUB-EST2025), released May 2026.
definition: Resident population within Census place boundaries, as of January 1, 2025. This list is the source file geographic summary level 162 (incorporated place), including the special cases the Census Bureau places in that level; it does not represent metro areas or all unincorporated communities.
selection: SUMLEV = 162; population = POPESTIMATE2025; all 19,483 records retained, including four places estimated to have zero residents.
tieOrder: Equal population estimates are ordered alphabetically by the Census geographic name, including state. Ranks are list positions, so ties still occupy separate numbered positions.
verification: All 1959 records in the Census published table SUB-IP-EST2025-ANNRNK were cross-checked against this snapshot for matching names and populations.
